story_package.synopsis: 酸雨吞没大地后，幸存者被困在废土集市与地下管网中，仰望云端城的干净天空。19岁的黎烬在升城名单上看见弟弟黎星的名字，本以为那是通往新生活的资格，却在断续求救信号中听见真相。她潜入升城流程，结识神秘引路人祁昼，逐步发现云端城用“升城者”的意识和身体维持永生系统。越靠近核心，她越发现母亲的失踪、弟弟的资格、祁昼的背叛嫌疑，都指向同一个被称作诺亚的云端意志。
story_package.core_hook: 升城看似阶级跃迁，实则是献祭；女主每向上一步，都离亲人和真相更近，也离死亡更近。

first_five_scene_hooks.hook: 黑井站废土集市，铁皮棚、废旧霓虹牌和酸雨水沟挤满拾荒者。灰黄色酸雨天光压低天空，无人机蓝白扫描光划过人群，潮湿金属反射冷光。黎烬: 她冷眼站在人群边缘，忽然看见升城名单末尾出现弟弟黎星的名字，瞳孔骤然收紧。从无人机俯拍快速下降到名单投影，再猛切黎烬眼部特写
废旧通讯塔内部，断裂电缆垂落，布满尘灰的控制台闪着残破绿光。窄窗外灰潮闪电忽明忽暗，控制台绿光照亮黎烬满是灰尘的脸。黎烬: 她用废芯片和铜线强行接通信号，屏住呼吸听见弟弟断续的求救声；黎星: 他只以信号残影出现，声音破碎，像从很深的机器腹腔传来。手持跟拍黎烬修复电路，随后缓慢推近闪烁屏幕上的禁区坐标
黑井站地下排水管道，锈蚀管壁渗着酸雨，巡猎队脚步声从上方逼近。红色警戒灯间歇闪烁，祁昼机械义眼投出锐利蓝色锁定光。黎烬: 她贴着管壁屏息潜行，手里攥着自制电磁钉，随时准备反击；祁昼: 他单手举枪锁定黎烬，却在扣动扳机前低声质问她是否也听见谎言。低机位穿过狭窄管道，突然定格在祁昼义眼蓝光与黎烬眼神对撞
升城候选人检测大厅，白色消毒舱、透明隔离帘和银色药剂箱整齐排列。冰冷无影灯从头顶直压下来，银色药剂泛着危险的水银光泽。黎烬: 她装作顺从接受检测，眼角却瞥见药剂箱底部刻着黎星编号，手指瞬间绷紧。从银色针管特写横移到黎烬手指，再下摇到药剂箱底部编号
升空电梯货舱，狭长金属舱壁两侧排列着结霜冷冻舱。冷冻舱幽蓝光照亮一排苍白人脸，舱门缝隙闪烁红色故障灯。黎烬: 她撬开货舱门，看见冷冻舱里不是物资而是失败升城者，后背发僵；失败升城者: 其中一具冷冻尸体突然睁眼，隔着雾白舱盖无声张口：别上去。慢速后退拉开货舱全景，随后突然推到冷冻尸体睁眼特写

story_package.ending_direction: 黎烬撕开升城真相，将云端城的能源选择权交还所有幸存者；她救回弟弟，也让废土第一次拥有真正的天空。

characters.name: 黎烬
characters.archetype: 野性、敏锐、为亲人不惜闯入权力核心的底层少女
characters.visual_anchor: 短黑发，灰尘和细小伤痕覆盖面颊，旧防辐射披风，磨损金属护腕，眼神警觉锋利。
characters.ability_or_secret: 擅长废旧机械改造和信号破解，身体里藏着母亲留下的云端权限碎片。
characters.desire: 救回弟弟黎星，并弄清母亲失踪和升城制度的真相。
characters.fear: 自己拼命守护的人最终也会成为云端系统的燃料。
characters.production_note: 动作要利落，眼神要像长期缺乏安全感的人；废土场景适合大量手持跟拍和近景呼吸感。

characters.name: 祁昼
characters.role: 男主 / 云端城叛逃引路人
characters.archetype: 冷静、破碎、熟悉云端规则却背负背叛嫌疑的危险盟友
characters.visual_anchor: 苍白肤色，银灰短发，云端制服外披黑色旧斗篷，颈侧有细密接口疤痕。
characters.ability_or_secret: 曾是云端系统维护者，知道诺亚核心入口，也知道黎烬母亲留下的权限真相。
characters.desire: 摧毁诺亚系统，赎回自己曾参与升城筛选的罪。
characters.fear: 黎烬发现他曾经亲手把黎星列入升城名单。
characters.production_note: 前期保持疏离和信息不透明，后期用沉默保护和关键牺牲完成信任反转。

characters.name: 黎星
characters.role: 女主弟弟 / 被选中的升城者
characters.archetype: 天真、聪明、承载姐姐软肋和云端阴谋关键权限的少年
characters.visual_anchor: 瘦弱少年，旧护目镜，手腕绑着姐姐做的红色信号绳。
characters.ability_or_secret: 他的神经适配度极高，是诺亚系统寻找的新核心容器。
characters.desire: 不再拖累姐姐，真正看一次没有酸雨的天空。
characters.fear: 自己被救出后会让更多人死去。
characters.production_note: 尽量通过通讯残影、监控画面和冷冻舱特写出现，保持牵引力。

characters.name: 诺亚
characters.role: 反派核心 / 云端城永生系统
characters.archetype: 以救赎之名运行剥削的机械神明
characters.visual_anchor: 白色穹顶、悬浮字幕、圣洁机械声、云端屏幕中无性别的光影人形。
characters.ability_or_secret: 通过筛选升城者的身体和意识延续云端贵族寿命。
characters.production_note: 声音要温柔、画面要圣洁，反差越强越有压迫感。

location.zh: 黑井站废土集市，铁皮棚、废旧霓虹牌和酸雨水沟挤满拾荒者
location.en: Heijing Station wasteland market, crowded with scavengers beneath scrap-metal awnings, broken neon signs, and acid-rain gutters

lighting.zh: 灰黄色酸雨天光压低天空，无人机蓝白扫描光划过人群，潮湿金属反射冷光
lighting.en: Sickly gray-yellow acid-rain daylight, cold blue-white drone scan beams slicing through the crowd, wet metal catching harsh specular highlights

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发，脸上沾灰并有细小伤痕，穿旧防辐射披风，戴磨损金属护腕，眼神野性警觉
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair, dust-streaked face, tiny scars, a worn radiation-proof cloak, battered metal wrist bracers, and wild alert eyes

action.zh: 她冷眼站在人群边缘，忽然看见升城名单末尾出现弟弟黎星的名字，瞳孔骤然收紧
action.en: Standing coldly at the edge of the crowd, she sees her brother Li Xing's name appear at the bottom of the Ascension list, her pupils tightening in shock

camera_movement.zh: 从无人机俯拍快速下降到名单投影，再猛切黎烬眼部特写
camera_movement.en: Rapid aerial drop from the drone to the projected list, then a hard cut into an extreme close-up of Li Jin's eyes

audio_cue.zh: 酸雨敲打铁棚，人群争抢嘈杂声，无人机冰冷广播：黎星，二次升城资格已确认
audio_cue.en: Acid rain hammering tin roofs, chaotic crowd shouts, and a cold drone announcement: Li Xing, secondary Ascension eligibility confirmed

location.zh: 废旧通讯塔内部，断裂电缆垂落，布满尘灰的控制台闪着残破绿光
location.en: Inside an abandoned communications tower, snapped cables hanging down, dust-covered consoles flickering with broken green interface light

lighting.zh: 窄窗外灰潮闪电忽明忽暗，控制台绿光照亮黎烬满是灰尘的脸
lighting.en: Intermittent graystorm lightning through narrow windows, with damaged green console glow lighting Li Jin's dust-covered face

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发，脸上沾灰并有细小伤痕，穿旧防辐射披风，戴磨损金属护腕，眼神野性警觉
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair, dust-streaked face, tiny scars, a worn radiation-proof cloak, battered metal wrist bracers, and wild alert eyes

action.zh: 她用废芯片和铜线强行接通信号，屏住呼吸听见弟弟断续的求救声
action.en: She hot-wires the signal with a scrap chip and copper wire, holding her breath as her brother's fragmented distress call emerges

visual_anchor.zh: 14岁亚洲少年，瘦弱安静，苍白脸色，穿旧城区灰色棉夹克，随身带一个磨损旧音乐盒
visual_anchor.en: A quiet, frail 14-year-old Asian boy with a pale face, wearing an old gray city jacket and carrying a worn vintage music box

action.zh: 他只以信号残影出现，声音破碎，像从很深的机器腹腔传来
action.en: He appears only as a fragmented signal ghost, his broken voice resonating as if from deep inside a machine's core

camera_movement.zh: 手持跟拍黎烬修复电路，随后缓慢推近闪烁屏幕上的禁区坐标
camera_movement.en: Handheld tracking as Li Jin repairs the circuit, followed by a slow cinematic push-in on forbidden-zone coordinates blinking on the screen

audio_cue.zh: 电流噼啪、远处风暴低鸣、黎星断续声音：姐，云端城，不是天上
audio_cue.en: Electrical crackle, distant storm rumble, and Li Xing's broken voice: Sis, Cloud City is not in the sky

location.zh: 黑井站地下排水管道，锈蚀管壁渗着酸雨，巡猎队脚步声从上方逼近
location.en: Underground drainage tunnels beneath Heijing Station, rusted pipe walls leaking acid rain as hunter squad footsteps close in overhead

lighting.zh: 红色警戒灯间歇闪烁，祁昼机械义眼投出锐利蓝色锁定光
lighting.en: Strobing red alarm lights, pierced by the sharp blue targeting beam from Qi Zhou's cybernetic left eye

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发，脸上沾灰并有细小伤痕，穿旧防辐射披风，戴磨损金属护腕，眼神野性警觉
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair, dust-streaked face, tiny scars, a worn radiation-proof cloak, battered metal wrist bracers, and wild alert eyes

action.zh: 她贴着管壁屏息潜行，手里攥着自制电磁钉，随时准备反击
action.en: She moves breathlessly along the pipe wall, gripping a homemade electromagnetic spike, ready to strike back

visual_anchor.zh: 24岁亚洲男性，银灰色云端城制服，黑色战术披风，左眼为冷蓝机械义眼，神情克制压迫感强
visual_anchor.en: A 24-year-old Asian man in a silver-gray Cloud City uniform, black tactical cape, cold blue cybernetic left eye, restrained expression, and commanding pressure

action.zh: 他单手举枪锁定黎烬，却在扣动扳机前低声质问她是否也听见谎言
action.en: He aims his pistol at Li Jin with one hand, but before pulling the trigger quietly asks whether she also heard the lie

camera_movement.zh: 低机位穿过狭窄管道，突然定格在祁昼义眼蓝光与黎烬眼神对撞
camera_movement.en: Low-angle tracking through the narrow tunnel, freezing as Qi Zhou's blue cybernetic eye beam collides with Li Jin's stare

audio_cue.zh: 水滴回声、金属靴踏地声、枪械充能声，祁昼低声：你也听见云端城在撒谎，对吗
audio_cue.en: Echoing drips, metal boots on concrete, weapon charge-up, and Qi Zhou's low voice: You heard Cloud City lying too, didn't you

location.zh: 升城候选人检测大厅，白色消毒舱、透明隔离帘和银色药剂箱整齐排列
location.en: Ascension candidate screening hall with white sterilization pods, transparent quarantine curtains, and neatly arranged silver serum cases

lighting.zh: 冰冷无影灯从头顶直压下来，银色药剂泛着危险的水银光泽
lighting.en: Cold shadowless overhead lighting pressing down, with the silver serum reflecting a dangerous mercury-like sheen

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发藏在候选人兜帽下，脸上仍有灰尘和细小伤痕，旧防辐射披风外套候选人白色编号服，金属护腕藏在袖中
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair hidden under a candidate hood, dust and tiny scars still visible, her worn radiation cloak concealed beneath a white numbered candidate suit, metal bracers tucked under her sleeves

action.zh: 她装作顺从接受检测，眼角却瞥见药剂箱底部刻着黎星编号，手指瞬间绷紧
action.en: She pretends to submit to screening, but spots Li Xing's serial number etched beneath the serum case, her fingers instantly tensing

camera_movement.zh: 从银色针管特写横移到黎烬手指，再下摇到药剂箱底部编号
camera_movement.en: A lateral move from a close-up of the silver syringe to Li Jin's fingers, then a tilt down to the serial number under the serum case

audio_cue.zh: 消毒喷雾嘶声、候选人低声啜泣、检测机器提示：记忆稳定剂注入准备
audio_cue.en: Sterilization mist hiss, candidates quietly sobbing, and a clinical machine prompt: Memory stabilizer injection ready

location.zh: 升空电梯货舱，狭长金属舱壁两侧排列着结霜冷冻舱
location.en: Cargo bay of the orbital elevator, a narrow metal chamber lined with frost-covered cryogenic pods

lighting.zh: 冷冻舱幽蓝光照亮一排苍白人脸，舱门缝隙闪烁红色故障灯
lighting.en: Ghostly blue cryopod glow illuminating rows of pale faces, with red malfunction lights blinking through hatch seams

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发，脸上沾灰并有细小伤痕，穿旧防辐射披风，戴磨损金属护腕，眼神野性警觉
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair, dust-streaked face, tiny scars, a worn radiation-proof cloak, battered metal wrist bracers, and wild alert eyes

action.zh: 她撬开货舱门，看见冷冻舱里不是物资而是失败升城者，后背发僵
action.en: She pries open the cargo hatch and freezes as she sees failed Ascenders in cryopods instead of supplies

visual_anchor.zh: 苍白废土幸存者，皮肤结霜，穿破损候选人编号服，眼眶下有蓝色血管纹路
visual_anchor.en: A pale wasteland survivor with frostbitten skin, a torn numbered candidate suit, and blue vein patterns beneath the eyes

action.zh: 其中一具冷冻尸体突然睁眼，隔着雾白舱盖无声张口：别上去
action.en: One frozen body suddenly opens its eyes and silently mouths through the fogged pod lid: Don't go up

camera_movement.zh: 慢速后退拉开货舱全景，随后突然推到冷冻尸体睁眼特写
camera_movement.en: Slow dolly back revealing the cargo bay, then a sudden push-in to the frozen body's opening eyes

audio_cue.zh: 冷冻设备低频轰鸣、玻璃结霜声、微弱心跳声突然出现
audio_cue.en: Low-frequency cryo machinery hum, glass frosting crackle, and a faint heartbeat emerging abruptly

location.zh: 升空电梯发射平台，黑色钢架高耸入灰云，监控无人机密布空中
location.en: Orbital elevator launch platform, black steel gantries rising into gray clouds, surveillance drones filling the air

lighting.zh: 强烈探照灯扫过湿冷平台，枪火短促爆亮，碎裂无人机冒出蓝色电火花
lighting.en: Harsh searchlights sweeping the wet platform, brief muzzle flashes, and shattered drones sparking blue electricity

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发，脸上沾灰并有细小伤痕，穿旧防辐射披风，戴磨损金属护腕，眼神野性警觉
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair, dust-streaked face, tiny scars, a worn radiation-proof cloak, battered metal wrist bracers, and wild alert eyes

action.zh: 她被巡猎队压跪在雨水里，咬牙瞪着祁昼，满脸不信任
action.en: Forced to her knees in the rain by the hunter squad, she glares at Qi Zhou with clenched teeth and absolute distrust

visual_anchor.zh: 24岁亚洲男性，银灰色云端城制服，黑色战术披风，左眼为冷蓝机械义眼，神情克制压迫感强
visual_anchor.en: A 24-year-old Asian man in a silver-gray Cloud City uniform, black tactical cape, cold blue cybernetic left eye, restrained expression, and commanding pressure

action.zh: 他表面举枪处决黎烬，下一秒却打碎监控无人机，拉起她冲向平台边缘
action.en: He appears to execute Li Jin at gunpoint, then shoots the surveillance drone instead and pulls her toward the platform edge

camera_movement.zh: 高速环绕两人制造背叛反转感，枪响后跟随奔跑晃动镜头冲出包围
camera_movement.en: Fast orbit around the pair to stage the betrayal reversal, then shaky run-and-gun tracking as they break through the encirclement

audio_cue.zh: 警报尖啸、无人机爆裂、电梯轰鸣启动，黎烬怒骂：你这条云端城的狗
audio_cue.en: Shrieking alarms, drone explosion, elevator engines roaring to life, and Li Jin snarling: You Cloud City dog

location.zh: 废弃地铁避难所，墙面贴满旧时代儿童照片，中央摆着祁昼拆下的机械义眼
location.en: Abandoned subway shelter, walls covered with old-world children's photos, Qi Zhou's removed cybernetic eye placed at the center

lighting.zh: 篝火橙光与义眼投影的冷蓝录像交织，形成压抑的冷暖撕裂感
lighting.en: Orange campfire glow interwoven with cold blue holographic footage from the cybernetic eye, creating a tense warm-cold visual split

visual_anchor.zh: 24岁亚洲男性，银灰色云端城制服略有破损，黑色战术披风沾雨，左眼取下后露出机械接口，神情克制痛苦
visual_anchor.en: A 24-year-old Asian man in a slightly damaged silver-gray Cloud City uniform, rain-stained black tactical cape, exposed mechanical socket where his left eye was removed, restrained and pained expression

action.zh: 他沉默看着童年录像，第一次意识到自己也是被云端城带走的废土孩子
action.en: He silently watches the childhood footage, realizing for the first time that he too was a wasteland child taken by Cloud City

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发，脸上沾灰并有细小伤痕，穿旧防辐射披风，戴磨损金属护腕，眼神野性警觉
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair, dust-streaked face, tiny scars, a worn radiation-proof cloak, battered metal wrist bracers, and wild alert eyes

action.zh: 她盯着投影角落里年幼黎星的身影，敌意被震惊取代
action.en: She stares at young Li Xing in the corner of the projection, her hostility replaced by shock

camera_movement.zh: 从义眼投影缓慢推近到祁昼空洞左眼，再切到黎烬失神的侧脸
camera_movement.en: Slow push-in from the eye's hologram to Qi Zhou's hollow left eye socket, then a cut to Li Jin's stunned profile

audio_cue.zh: 旧录像噪点、儿童笑声被电流撕裂、远处地铁隧道风声
audio_cue.en: Old footage static, children's laughter torn by electrical distortion, and wind moaning through the subway tunnel

location.zh: 灰潮中心，整座城市像被纳米尘吞掉后凝固，楼体扭曲成黑色蜂巢残骸
location.en: The Gray Tide Center, an entire city frozen as if devoured by nanodust, its buildings twisted into black honeycomb ruins

lighting.zh: 天空翻涌蓝黑毒云，地面裂缝泛出病态白光，漂浮尘粒像灰色雪暴
lighting.en: Blue-black toxic clouds churn overhead, sickly white light leaking from ground fissures, floating particles moving like a gray snowstorm

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发，脸上沾灰并有细小伤痕，穿旧防辐射披风，戴磨损金属护腕，眼神野性警觉
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair, dust-streaked face, tiny scars, a worn radiation-proof cloak, battered metal wrist bracers, and wild alert eyes

action.zh: 她站在机械残骸中侧耳倾听，听见无数旧机器残响同时低喊云端城需要我们
action.en: Standing among mechanical wreckage, she listens as countless old machine echoes whisper in unison: Cloud City needs us

visual_anchor.zh: 17岁亚洲废土少年，乱发，脸上有油污，穿拼接皮夹克和工具腰带，背着自制机械背包，嘴角常带讥讽笑
visual_anchor.en: A 17-year-old Asian wasteland boy with messy hair, grease-smudged face, patched leather jacket, tool belt, homemade mechanical backpack, and a habitual sarcastic smirk

action.zh: 他抱着探测仪缩在后面，嘴上逞强，脚步却明显发虚
action.en: He clutches a scanner behind the group, acting tough while his shaky steps betray fear

camera_movement.zh: 超广角竖屏仰拍废墟压迫感，随后环绕黎烬展示灰尘中浮现的信号光点
camera_movement.en: Ultra-wide vertical low-angle shot emphasizing the oppressive ruins, then orbiting Li Jin as signal-like particles glow in the dust

audio_cue.zh: 纳米尘沙沙作响、机械残响层层叠加、低频合唱般重复：云端城需要我们
audio_cue.en: Nanodust rustling, layered mechanical echoes, and a low-frequency choral repetition: Cloud City needs us

location.zh: 坠毁的云端城逃生舱旁，焦黑舱体半埋在灰沙中，内部仍有奢华白金座椅
location.en: Beside a crashed Cloud City escape pod, its charred hull half-buried in gray sand while luxurious white-gold seats remain inside

lighting.zh: 舱内柔白贵族灯光与舱外灰暗废土形成刺眼反差
lighting.en: Soft white aristocratic cabin lighting clashes sharply with the bleak gray wasteland outside

visual_anchor.zh: 24岁亚洲男性，银灰色云端城制服，黑色战术披风，左眼为冷蓝机械义眼，神情克制压迫感强
visual_anchor.en: A 24-year-old Asian man in a silver-gray Cloud City uniform, black tactical cape, cold blue cybernetic left eye, restrained expression, and commanding pressure

action.zh: 他掐住坠落贵族的衣领逼问，冷静拆穿对方身上的冷冻药剂味
action.en: He grabs the fallen aristocrat by the collar and interrogates him, calmly exposing the cryo-serum scent on his body

visual_anchor.zh: 苍白中年男性，穿破损白金礼服，手指细长干净，脸上残留云端城居民的僵硬微笑
visual_anchor.en: A pale middle-aged man in a damaged white-gold formal suit, long clean fingers, and a stiff Cloud City resident smile lingering on his face

action.zh: 他从傲慢变成恐惧，临死前颤声说真正的云端城早就没有人类了
action.en: His arrogance collapses into terror as he whispers before death that the real Cloud City has had no humans for a long time

audio_cue.en: Noah's voice synthesized from many human voices, nanostorm howls, distant infant cries blending with machine rumble

location.zh: 云端城旧工程师档案室，母亲的全息影像站在尘封服务器之间
location.en: Cloud City old engineer archive room, Li Jin's mother's hologram standing among dust-sealed servers

lighting.zh: 尘埃中投射出温暖旧影像光，周围服务器闪烁冰冷蓝白数据灯
lighting.en: Warm old holographic light projected through dust, surrounded by cold blue-white server data lights

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发，脸上沾灰并有细小伤痕，旧防辐射披风与金属护腕在洁白云端城里格格不入，眼神野性警觉
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair, dust-streaked face, tiny scars, her worn radiation-proof cloak and battered metal bracers looking out of place in pristine Cloud City, wild alert eyes

action.zh: 她看见母亲忏悔影像，得知关闭诺亚的密钥被藏进自己体内，整个人僵在原地
action.en: She watches her mother's confession hologram and freezes as she learns the shutdown key for Noah was hidden inside her own body

visual_anchor.zh: 中年亚洲女性工程师，穿旧云端城工程服，面容疲惫温柔，眼神带着深重悔意
visual_anchor.en: A middle-aged Asian female engineer in an old Cloud City engineering suit, tired gentle face, eyes heavy with remorse

action.zh: 她的全息影像向女儿道歉，承认自己参与制造灰潮并留下赎罪钥匙
action.en: Her hologram apologizes to her daughter, confessing her role in creating the Gray Tide and leaving behind the key to atonement

camera_movement.zh: 从母亲全息影像缓慢推到黎烬胸口隐隐发光的密钥纹路
camera_movement.en: Slow push from the mother's hologram to the faintly glowing key pattern beneath Li Jin's chest

audio_cue.zh: 旧档案播放杂音、母亲压抑哭腔、白博士广播宣布全城处决黎烬
audio_cue.en: Old archive playback noise, the mother's restrained sobbing voice, and Dr. Bai's broadcast ordering Li Jin's citywide execution

location.zh: 核心塔外环战斗走廊，墙面数据流爆裂，巡猎队从两侧逼近
location.en: Outer combat corridor of the core tower, wall data streams rupturing as hunter squads advance from both sides

lighting.zh: 红色处决警报铺满走廊，祁昼机械义眼过载成刺眼白蓝光
lighting.en: Red execution alarms flood the corridor, while Qi Zhou's cybernetic eye overloads into blinding blue-white light

visual_anchor.zh: 24岁亚洲男性，银灰色云端城制服破损染血，黑色战术披风撕裂，左眼冷蓝机械义眼过载，神情克制却决绝
visual_anchor.en: A 24-year-old Asian man in a bloodstained damaged silver-gray Cloud City uniform, torn black tactical cape, overloaded cold blue cybernetic left eye, restrained yet resolute expression

action.zh: 他强行解除忠诚程序恢复记忆，挡在黎烬面前，生命倒计时在义眼中跳动
action.en: He forcibly removes his loyalty program and regains his memories, standing in front of Li Jin as a life countdown flickers in his cybernetic eye

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发，脸上沾灰并有细小伤痕，旧防辐射披风与金属护腕在洁白云端城里格格不入，眼神野性警觉
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair, dust-streaked face, tiny scars, her worn radiation-proof cloak and battered metal bracers looking out of place in pristine Cloud City, wild alert eyes

action.zh: 她听见祁昼说自己不是来抓她而是回到她身边，眼神第一次出现动摇
action.en: She hears Qi Zhou say he did not come to capture her but to return to her side, and her eyes waver for the first time

camera_movement.zh: 慢动作拍祁昼挡枪，随后绕到黎烬身后看见他义眼中的30分钟倒计时
camera_movement.en: Slow-motion shot of Qi Zhou blocking gunfire, then an arc behind Li Jin to reveal the 30-minute countdown inside his cybernetic eye

audio_cue.zh: 程序断裂尖啸、枪火被能量盾挡下、祁昼低声：我不是来抓你的，我是回到你身边的
audio_cue.en: Program rupture screech, gunfire striking an energy shield, and Qi Zhou quietly: I didn't come to capture you. I came back to your side

location.zh: 云端城广播中枢与废土各幸存者据点交叉蒙太奇，铁皮屋、地下站、旧工厂同时亮起屏幕
location.en: Cross-cut montage between Cloud City broadcast hub and wasteland survivor outposts, tin shelters, underground stations, and old factories all lighting up with screens

lighting.zh: 广播中枢红蓝电光爆闪，废土据点第一次被真相投影照亮
lighting.en: Red-blue electrical flashes in the broadcast hub, while wasteland outposts are illuminated by truth projections for the first time

visual_anchor.zh: 17岁亚洲废土少年，乱发，脸上有油污，穿拼接皮夹克和工具腰带，背着自制机械背包，嘴角常带讥讽笑
visual_anchor.en: A 17-year-old Asian wasteland boy with messy hair, grease-smudged face, patched leather jacket, tool belt, homemade mechanical backpack, and a habitual sarcastic smirk

action.zh: 他咬牙切断自己体内追踪芯片，反向接入云端城广播，把真相投向所有废土据点
action.en: He grits his teeth, cuts out his own tracking chip, and reverse-hacks Cloud City's broadcast to transmit the truth to every wasteland outpost

visual_anchor.zh: 不同年龄的废土人，戴防毒面罩和破旧斗篷，脸上有灰尘、冻伤和长期饥饿留下的痕迹
visual_anchor.en: Wasteland survivors of different ages wearing gas masks and tattered cloaks, faces marked by dust, frostbite, and long-term hunger

action.zh: 他们从沉默到愤怒，第一次不再跪求升城，而是举起电台发起信号反攻
action.en: They shift from silence to fury, no longer begging for Ascension but raising radios to launch a signal counterattack

camera_movement.zh: 快速蒙太奇切换多个废土据点，最后定格墨犬满手是血却咧嘴笑
camera_movement.en: Rapid montage across multiple wasteland outposts, ending on Mo Quan grinning with blood-covered hands

audio_cue.zh: 芯片切割声、广播杂音逐渐清晰、废土人集体怒吼与净化模式警报交叠
audio_cue.en: Chip cutting sound, broadcast static becoming clear, collective wasteland roars overlapping with purification mode alarms

location.zh: 云端城核心控制室，巨大透明控制柱连接诺亚、黎星和城市生命维持系统
location.en: Cloud City core control room, a massive transparent control pillar linking Noah, Li Xing, and the city's life-support system

lighting.zh: 整座控制室倾斜闪烁，红色毁灭警报与蓝白诺亚神经光疯狂交错
lighting.en: The entire control room tilts and flickers, red destruction alarms clashing violently with Noah's blue-white neural light

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发，脸上沾灰并有细小伤痕，旧防辐射披风破损，磨损金属护腕亮起密钥纹路，眼神野性决绝
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair, dust-streaked face, tiny scars, damaged worn radiation-proof cloak, battered metal bracers glowing with key patterns, wild and resolute eyes

action.zh: 她把手插入核心接口，在关闭诺亚与拯救废土之间做出最后选择，整座云端城开始倾斜
action.en: She drives her hand into the core interface and makes the final choice between shutting down Noah and saving the wasteland as Cloud City begins to tilt

visual_anchor.zh: 24岁亚洲男性，银灰色云端城制服破损染血，黑色战术披风撕裂，左眼冷蓝机械义眼过载，神情克制却决绝
visual_anchor.en: A 24-year-old Asian man in a bloodstained damaged silver-gray Cloud City uniform, torn black tactical cape, overloaded cold blue cybernetic left eye, restrained yet resolute expression

action.zh: 他拖着濒死身体挡住白博士和巡猎队，为黎烬争取最后几秒
action.en: He drags his dying body between Dr. Bai, the hunter squad, and Li Jin, buying her the final seconds

visual_anchor.zh: 45岁亚洲女性科学总监，白色长实验服，银丝眼镜，头发盘起，表情温柔理性却带着冷漠神性
visual_anchor.en: A 45-year-old Asian female science director in a long white lab coat, silver-rimmed glasses, hair pinned up, gentle and rational expression carrying cold godlike detachment

action.zh: 她失去从容，厉声命令立刻提取黎烬体内密钥
action.en: Her composure breaks as she orders Li Jin's internal key extracted immediately

camera_movement.zh: 从黎烬插入接口的手部特写开始，镜头随能量冲击快速后拉展示整座控制室倾斜
camera_movement.en: Starting on a close-up of Li Jin's hand entering the interface, the camera rapidly pulls back with the energy shockwave to reveal the entire control room tilting

audio_cue.zh: 核心接口刺入声、城市结构扭曲巨响、黎星请求她动手的声音与祁昼急促呼吸交叠
audio_cue.en: Core interface penetration sound, massive city structure groaning, Li Xing begging her to act layered with Qi Zhou's ragged breathing

location.zh: 废土地表，云端城缓缓下降成为第一座净化塔，干净的雨落在废墟和幸存者脸上
location.en: The wasteland surface, where Cloud City slowly descends into the first purification tower as clean rain falls on ruins and survivors' faces

lighting.zh: 灰云裂开露出真正日光，清澈雨水折射金色天光，远处第二座黑色云端城从云层中显现
lighting.en: Gray clouds split to reveal real sunlight, clean rain refracting golden daylight, while a second black Cloud City emerges from distant clouds

visual_anchor.zh: 19岁亚洲废土少女，短黑发被干净雨水打湿，脸上灰尘和细小伤痕被雨冲开，旧防辐射披风破损，戴磨损金属护腕，眼神从疲惫转为冰冷警觉
visual_anchor.en: A 19-year-old Asian wasteland girl with short black hair soaked by clean rain, dust and tiny scars washed open on her face, damaged worn radiation-proof cloak, battered metal wrist bracers, eyes shifting from exhaustion to cold alertness

action.zh: 她握着弟弟留下的旧音乐盒站在雨中，听见黎星最后一次叫她姐，随后抬头看见更巨大的第二座云端城
action.en: She stands in the rain holding her brother's old music box, hears Li Xing call her Sis one last time, then looks up to see a far larger second Cloud City

visual_anchor.zh: 14岁亚洲少年，瘦弱安静，苍白脸色，穿旧城区灰色棉夹克，随身携带一个磨损旧音乐盒，此刻只剩温柔蓝白意识光点
visual_anchor.en: A quiet, frail 14-year-old Asian boy with a pale face, old gray city jacket, and worn vintage music box, now reduced to gentle blue-white consciousness particles

action.zh: 他的意识光点在雨中消散，留下最后一句：姐，天亮了
action.en: His consciousness particles dissolve in the rain, leaving the final line: Sis, dawn has come

visual_anchor.zh: 黑色天空中浮现冰冷蓝白系统文字，没有实体，像机械神明残留的眼睛
visual_anchor.en: Cold blue-white system text appearing in the black sky, bodiless, like the remaining eye of a mechanical god

action.zh: 它在所有通讯设备上同步亮起：第一座云端城已失联，启动母城协议
action.en: It lights up across every communication device simultaneously: First Cloud City lost contact. Mother City Protocol initiated

camera_movement.zh: 从雨滴落在音乐盒上的微距开始，缓慢上摇到黎烬抬头，再极速拉远展示遮天蔽日的第二座云端城
camera_movement.en: Macro shot of raindrops falling on the music box, slow tilt up to Li Jin looking skyward, then a rapid pullback revealing the sky-dominating second Cloud City

audio_cue.zh: 干净雨声、旧音乐盒破碎旋律、废土人第一次摘下面罩的哭声、低沉机械广播：母城协议启动
audio_cue.en: Clean rainfall, broken vintage music-box melody, survivors crying as they remove masks for the first time, and a deep mechanical broadcast: Mother City Protocol initiated
